code-generated.label: Drawn by code
code-generated.description: No art files. The AI wrote code that builds the visuals: primitives, shaders, procedural textures and models.

ai-2d.label: AI images (2D)
ai-2d.description: Sprites, textures, panoramas or key art from image models such as GPT Image, DALL-E, Flux or Nano Banana.

ai-3d.label: AI 3D models
ai-3d.description: Meshes from image-to-3D or text-to-3D models such as Tripo, Meshy, CSM, Hunyuan3D or Rodin.

hand-made.label: Hand-made art
hand-made.description: Drawn or modeled by people (Blender, Aseprite, Photoshop...), including the creator's own cleanup of AI output.

asset-pack.label: Asset packs
asset-pack.description: Ready-made models, animations and textures: Kenney, Quaternius, KayKit, Mixamo, Sketchfab, Poly Haven, itch.io packs.

ai-blender.label: AI-driven Blender
ai-blender.description: An AI agent operated Blender (e.g. through Blender MCP) to build the assets.

unknown.label: Undocumented
unknown.description: The creator hasn't said how the visuals were made.

ai-music.label: AI music
ai-music.description: Soundtrack from music models such as Suno or Udio.

ai-sfx.label: AI sound effects
ai-sfx.description: Sound effects from audio models such as ElevenLabs.

procedural.label: Synthesized in code
procedural.description: No audio files: sounds are generated live with the Web Audio API or similar.

stock.label: Stock / CC0 sounds
stock.description: Library sounds, e.g. freesound.org or CC0 packs.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: AI code editor; its agent mode drives Claude, GPT and Gemini models.

claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.description: Anthropic's terminal coding agent (incl. parallel sessions, Ultracode and /loop).

claude.label: Claude (chat)
claude.description: Claude in the chat app or API, with code pasted back and forth.

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT
chatgpt.description: OpenAI's chat app, also used for image generation.

gemini.label: Gemini
gemini.description: Google's models via the Gemini app, AI Studio or an IDE.

antigravity.label: Google Antigravity
antigravity.description: Google's agent-first AI IDE, which runs Gemini and Claude models.

grok.label: Grok
grok.description: xAI's chat model, popular in early 2025 for planning and multiplayer code.

animoca-minds.label: Animoca Minds
animoca-minds.description: AI 'Game Designer Mind' agent; the VibeBlitz jam required it for at least 50% of production.

verse8.label: Verse8 Agent8
verse8.description: Prompt-to-game agent on the Verse8 platform.

copilot.label: GitHub Copilot
copilot.description: AI pair programmer in the IDE.

replit.label: Replit Agent
replit.description: Browser IDE with a coding agent.

cline.label: Cline
cline.description: Open-source coding agent for VS Code.

one-shot.label: One-shot
one-shot.description: One prompt (or a handful) produced the game, often followed by long unattended agent loops.

iterative.label: Iterative prompting
iterative.description: Many rounds of prompt, playtest and paste-the-error-back with a main assistant.

agent-swarm.label: Agent swarm
agent-swarm.description: Several agents in parallel, or a lead agent orchestrating sub-agents.

jam-sprint.label: Jam sprint
jam-sprint.description: Built against a game-jam deadline, in days to a few weeks.

long-haul.label: Long haul
long-haul.description: Months of continued AI-driven development and live updates.

pro-assisted.label: Pro-assisted
pro-assisted.description: An experienced engineer steering AI as a power tool.

platform.label: Prompt-to-game platform
platform.description: Made inside a hosted AI game platform such as Verse8.

vibe-jam-2025.label: Vibe Jam 2025
vibe-jam-2025.description: levelsio's first Vibe Coding Game Jam: at least 80% AI-written code, 1,000+ entries, $17.5k in prizes.

vibe-jam-2026.label: Vibe Jam 2026
vibe-jam-2026.description: Cursor Vibe Jam 2026: at least 90% AI-written code, 945 entries, $40k podium plus 12 special prizes.

vibeblitz-2026.label: VibeBlitz 2026
vibeblitz-2026.description: YGG's VibeBlitz x Animoca Minds jam (July 2026), 72 submissions.

beginners-jam-2025.label: Beginner's Jam 2025
beginners-jam-2025.description: itch.io Beginner's Jam Summer 2025 (theme: Time Travel).

high.label: Well documented
high.description: Creator write-ups, public repos or several independent sources.

medium.label: Partly documented
medium.description: Some first-hand info, with gaps or single-source claims.

low.label: Thinly documented
low.description: Little first-hand info; treat the details as provisional.
